key_findings: Both graph arms supplied a graph built from the 20-candidate pool while displaying only five selected evidence snippets.
S7Q-009 graph provenance referenced three snippet IDs outside the displayed evidence package.
S7Q-011 graph provenance referenced one snippet ID outside the displayed evidence package.
Three automated claim verifications cited at least one hidden snippet ID.
The S7Q-011 prostate-cancer evidence describes TWIST1 phosphorylation/heterodimerization in prostate cancer cells, not a TWIST1 mutation association.
The same-model verifier accepted graph assertions as support, so the automated graph advantage is not scientifically valid.
summary.decision: Retain Stage 7C V1 as an auditable provenance-failure pilot. Rerun only the two graph arms with graph-selected text evidence but without graph assertions. Reuse the six valid hybrid baselines.

records.scientific_issue: Graph assertions and verifier citations were not closed to the five displayed evidence snippets.
